scope: Diagnostics only. No production runtime change, no whole-export speed or RSS claim. Larger-cap candidate rejected before browser adoption because isolated CPU does not beat spread.

fixture.description: One generated group copied to distinct addresses, 17 stored groups including one excluded hot group. 5 cold API passes in one owner/renderer process, prompt explicit release; verification poison off, normal validation on.

capture.scope: First 200 frame issuances of first pass. Actual requests/issuance/returns/governor-eviction chronology; synthetic bytes in replay.

browserDiagnostic.instrumentation: Observer counters and trace add memory/time. These are not CPU/RSS acceptance samples. Owner API flag is true; old generic outputRecycling field is false for that harness route and does not identify this API.

component.scope: Fixture load/warmup/GC excluded. Real ReturnPool and two-way structuredClone transfer, synthetic writes, validation/clear/eviction; no IO/decode/frame assembly/MessagePort latency. 5 fresh-process alternating pairs. CPU is process user+system; thread CPU also supplied. Candidates have identical outputs/checksum and reject no returns. Current source policy unchanged; only cap argument differs.

decision: Keep 4MiB production cap: 16MiB raises prefix hits 19205->29296/49260 and cuts allocated bytes 219300470->163619308, but CPU medians 630.530->636.387ms with overlapping ranges [566.880,639.119] and [604.524,653.484]. Thread medians 401.471->434.638ms. Wall medians 469.851->465.194ms overlap. No whole-export candidate accepted.
